Title: Pod security policy for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is now available in preview

Body.Content:
Now available in preview, pod security policy for AKS enables fine-grained authorization of pod creation and updates. It allows you to set up policies to validate requests to pods and define a set of conditions that a pod must run with in order to be scheduled on the AKS cluster.

Learn more
